tasks.short: Prepare committee contributions, deliberate and separately record and communicate follow-up.

steps.what: Retrieve the committee agenda, institutional policies and relevant departmental papers
Write the member's briefing and proposed contribution on academic issues

loop.purpose: Draft the member's argument from the selected papers
loop.input: Agenda, verified papers and member-supplied position
loop.check: Member checks factual fidelity, policy meaning and the intended argument
loop.stop: One revision pass; unresolved or confidential content is written manually
loop.why_not_simpler: A briefing template does not express the issue-specific argument

steps.what: Serve on the committee, discuss proposals and exercise academic judgement
Record the member's assigned actions and write the follow-up contribution
Check the final follow-up and send it to the committee colleagues

tasks.design: Configure committee-paper links and action layouts in {DOCS} and {PROJECT}, with a bounded draft of the member's own briefing. Deliberation, follow-up writing and the actual send through {EMAIL} are separately timed; no official minutes or institutional approval authority is assigned to the member.
tasks.previous_blocker: Paper navigation, first-draft briefings and repeated action headings add preparation effort.
tasks.enabler_now: Native document layouts and source-linked drafting can reuse the committee pack.
tasks.still_hard: Balancing academic interests and exercising judgement on institutional issues.
tasks.human_edge: Accountable participation and negotiation with colleagues.
tasks.altitude: Prepare better grounded contributions with less repeated administration.

evidence.claim: Native committee templates and reviewed briefing drafts may reduce clerical preparation; this is an E1 scenario.

assumptions: The baseline includes the member's briefing and follow-up records, separately from meeting participation; official minutes remain the secretary's existing responsibility.

The member selects papers and supplies their position in s1-s2, then captures assigned action identity, owner and due date in s4 from the discussion. Missing details are clarified manually with effort retained.
Native paper links and action templates precede a model loop. No autonomous task creation or message dispatch is implied.
The author's ordinary internal saves remain fully retained with no self-approval gate.
unknowns: Whether committee material may enter the drafting environment
research_questions: Does a checked briefing draft reduce total preparation effort without misrepresenting policy or the member's position?

already_counted.description: Briefing review and member action entry

incremental.description: Maintain paper links and briefing checks

approvals.approved_version: Exact follow-up text, attachments and committee recipients checked immediately before sending; changes void approval.

time_saved_range_pct.basis: E1 central B100 R84 gives16 gross minus3 upkeep =13 net. Low: policy papers have weak references and most briefing prose is contested, leaving retrieval14, briefing18 and follow-up19 plus45 unchanged, R96; net1. High: papers are identifiable but nuanced arguments need editing, leaving13+14+17+45=89 retained; net8 after3 upkeep. Meeting judgement and actual sending remain full.

tasks.savings_basis: 100 focal-role baseline hours; external labour excluded; incremental focal work deducted once; provisional

tasks.short: Maintain office-hour availability, advise students and record and communicate needed follow-up.

steps.what: Maintain the regularly scheduled office hours in the existing calendar view
Retrieve relevant course information for the student's question
Listen, advise and assist students during office hours
Write brief advising notes and any agreed follow-up response
Check the final follow-up response and send it to the student

tasks.design: Use recurring entries in {CALENDAR}, linked course references in {LMS} and a short advising-note layout in {DOCS}. Individual conversation stays human; writing the note and sending any agreed follow-up through {EMAIL} are separate steps.
tasks.previous_blocker: Repeated calendar edits, reference navigation and note headings add small clerical effort.
tasks.enabler_now: Native recurring entries and linked reference and note views can remove repeated setup.
tasks.still_hard: Understanding the student's circumstances and giving suitable advice.
tasks.human_edge: Trust, attentive listening and individual judgement.
tasks.altitude: Protect advising time while reducing repeated preparation and note handling.

evidence.claim: Native recurring calendar entries and note templates may reduce existing administration; the saving estimate is E1.

assumptions: The baseline includes maintaining availability and existing brief notes and follow-up, averaged across office-hour contacts; it does not create a report for every conversation.
The teacher supplies availability in s1, identifies question and course in s2, and captures agreed follow-up in s4. Capture time remains counted; unclear details are confirmed manually.
Only native configuration is proposed. No automatic booking, calendar invitation or message publication is implied.
Ordinary author saves remain fully retained without approval. The separate gate applies to the actual follow-up send.
unknowns: Whether recurring entries and linked references already exist
research_questions: Do observed office hours show repeated calendar and record work that native settings can reduce?

already_counted.description: Human reference selection and advising-note entry

incremental.description: Maintain reference links and note layout

approvals.approved_version: Exact response, attachments and intended student checked before sending; no internal advising notes are included without that check.

time_saved_range_pct.basis: Central E1 B100 R92.25 gives7.75 gross minus1 upkeep =6.75 net. Low: calendar recurrence already exists and questions require bespoke references and notes, leaving10+10+14+65=99 retained; net0. High: recurring edits and course links repeat but advice notes remain individual, leaving9+8+13+65=95 retained; net4 after1 upkeep. Conversation and actual send stay full.

tasks.short: Develop and write a source-grounded grant proposal and separately submit the checked application.

steps.what: Retrieve the grant call, application requirements and supporting research information
outputs: checked application requirements and source pack

steps.what: Develop the research concept, method and proposed contribution
inputs: checked application requirements and source pack

steps.what: Write grant proposals from the research concept and verified supporting material
inputs: checked application requirements and source pack

loop.purpose: Draft a proposal narrative from the researcher's concept
loop.input: Call requirements, verified sources and researcher-supplied work plan
loop.output: Draft sections mapped to call questions and sources
loop.check: Researcher checks novelty, feasibility, evidence and every claim of prior work
loop.stop: One revision pass; unsupported claims or prohibited confidential material require manual writing
loop.why_not_simpler: A form template cannot express the project-specific research argument

steps.what: Prepare the budget justification and required application fields
inputs: checked application requirements and source pack

steps.what: Check feasibility, claims, budget consistency and the complete application package
inputs: checked application requirements and source pack

steps.what: Check the final application version and submit it for external research funding

tasks.design: Use native call layouts in {DOCS} and budget templates in {SPREADSHEET}, then draft the proposal narrative from the researcher's concept in a bounded loop. Full research judgement and consistency checks remain human, followed by a distinct final submission through {PARTNER_PORTAL}.
tasks.previous_blocker: Call navigation, first-draft narrative and repeated application fields consume effort.
tasks.enabler_now: Source-linked drafting and native application structures can reuse verified project material.
tasks.still_hard: Originality, credible methods, feasible costs and a persuasive contribution.
tasks.human_edge: Responsibility for the project promise and the evidence behind it.
tasks.altitude: Concentrate on proposal quality rather than repeated application handling.

evidence.claim: The digest treats proposal drafting as a source-grounded generation opportunity; labour benefit remains E1 model knowledge.
The digest reports restrictions on referees using confidential proposals; applicant drafting permissions must be checked separately.

assumptions: This task includes writing the proposal and the real submission, without inventing an extra institutional approval tier.
The researcher captures the call requirements in s1, produces concept and work plan in s2 and verifies cost estimates while preparing s4. Missing inputs require manual work, not inferred commitments.
Native call and budget templates precede narrative drafting. Existing spreadsheet calculations receive no new saving.
The researcher may submit the application in this scenario. Ordinary author saves remain fully retained without self-approval.
unknowns: Funder and institution rules on applicant drafting tools
Existing application templates and cost metadata
research_questions: Does one proposal draft reduce total effort after research, cost and call-compliance checking?

already_counted.description: Narrative review and full application consistency checking

incremental.description: Maintain call mapping and source-grounded drafting checks

approvals.approved_version: Exact narrative, budget, attachments, applicant details and funding call checked immediately before submission; any change requires a fresh check.

time_saved_range_pct.basis: Central E1 B100 R76.5 gives23.5 gross minus4 upkeep =19.5 net. Low: the call has bespoke evidence fields and most narrative is rewritten, leaving lookup14, narrative31, budget14 plus35 unchanged, R94; net2. High: a compatible call template and verified source pack reduce rewriting, leaving13+24+12+35=84 retained; net12 after4 upkeep. Original concept and final checking remain full.

tasks.savings_basis: 100 focal-role baseline hours; external labour excluded; incremental focal work deducted once; provisional

tasks.short: Direct departmental administration with separate decisions, records and staff communication.

steps.what: Retrieve departmental workload, budget and open administrative matters
Discuss departmental needs, constraints and administrative issues with colleagues
Decide departmental priorities, responsibilities and administrative responses
Write administrative decisions, assignments and the departmental action plan
Check the final assignments and communicate them to responsible colleagues
Update action status from colleagues' progress reports and resolve omissions

tasks.design: Configure existing departmental views in {PROJECT} and {ERP}, plus plan and status layouts in {DOCS}. Meetings and decisions stay human; recording assignments, communicating them through {EMAIL} and updating their later status are distinct actions.
tasks.previous_blocker: Administrative information is scattered and recurring action fields are repeatedly recreated.
tasks.enabler_now: Native filtered views and reusable action layouts can reduce navigation and entry.
tasks.still_hard: Balancing people, resources and academic priorities.
tasks.human_edge: Accountable leadership and negotiation with colleagues.
tasks.altitude: Lead the department from a clearer action record with less repeated administration.

evidence.claim: Native departmental views and record templates may reduce repeated administrative handling; benefit is an E1 scenario.

assumptions: This covers departmental administration including actual plan and assignment records. Separately assigned teaching and committee tasks are not re-counted as administrative output.

Existing systems supply workload and budget records in s1; the head creates assignments in s3-s4 and captures owner, due date and later progress status in s6 from colleague reports. Missing information is clarified manually.
Native views and forms precede custom software. No automatic ERP send, staff ranking or notification is implied.
Ordinary same-system record saves remain fully retained and ungated; the gate applies only to communicating the final assignment.
unknowns: Existing plan templates and action metadata
research_questions: Which recurring administrative record fields can native forms reduce without reducing leadership or follow-up judgement?

already_counted.description: Assignment record and later status entry

incremental.description: Maintain views and action record conventions

approvals.approved_version: Exact final responsibilities, dates, instruction text and colleague recipients checked before communication; any change voids approval.

time_saved_range_pct.basis: Central E1 B100 R90 gives10 gross minus2 upkeep =8 net. Low: workload sources use incompatible identifiers and plans are mostly bespoke, leaving lookup14, plan19 and status9 plus55 unchanged, R97; net1. High: native views align records but assignment wording remains individual, leaving13+17+8+55=93 retained; net5 after2 upkeep. Discussion, decisions and instruction send remain full.

tasks.savings_basis: 100 focal-role baseline hours; external labour excluded; incremental focal work deducted once; provisional

role.altitude: Keep institutional judgement and student relationships personal while making the supporting records easier to maintain.
reach: Prepare traceable committee and funding packs
Help departmental colleagues follow recorded assignments
role.ambitious_version: A teacher and academic leader with less repeated administration and more attention for students and institutional decisions.
